rationale: Objective control is scored in the COMMAND phase of every battle round from 2 onward (11e 25.1), so a marker nobody stands on is free victory points for whoever gets a model within range of it - for a terrain-hosted objective, a base touching its hosting area (14.02). Here U_CUSTODIAN_GUARD_B (OC 2, Move 6) is parked 2.5 inches north of obj_nml_1's ruin with no enemy within 30 inches and no other objective within a Move plus the best Advance: there is no threat to price, no competing objective in reach, and no reason to be anywhere else. An AI that does not close that 2.5 inches is not weighing a trade-off, it is failing to see the board. Assert 1 checks those premises on the engine, so the exam cannot silently drift onto a different board again.
setup: # The board is the CURRENT fixture's (rebuilt 2026-08-21 in 38cbaa3,
# mirrored 2026-10-25 in 6f07340): obj_nml_1 is the marker at (1500, 750)
# inside the dense ruin area-large-2 (x 1360-1640, y 520-980), and 11e
# 14.02 puts a model within range of a terrain-hosted objective as soon as
# its base touches the hosting area - so "N inches from obj_nml_1" means
# N inches from that area. (Written for the dbdb29f board, where obj_nml_1
# was an open-ground marker at (400, 880), this exam kept those coordinates
# through both rebuilds and graded a squad 28" from the objective.)
# The squad: a line 65 px apart at y 388.5, every 40 mm base 2.5" north
# of the ruin's top edge (y 520) and not touching it.
# Park every other model at 70 px spacing (bases are 32-40 mm, < 63 px):
# player 1 in the north-west corner, more than 24" from the ruin, so no
# other friendly is a rival for obj_nml_1; player 2 in the south-east, so
# no enemy is within 30" of the squad and there is no threat to price.

assert.name: precondition: the start line is 2.5" short of obj_nml_1's range (14.02), every other objective is more than a Move plus the best Advance (12") away, and no enemy is within 30"
